question: In the 15th century, a text called ______ is ascribed popularly to Lochan Kavi.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Raag Tarangini.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **The correct answer is option 4, "Raag Tarangini".**

 
 
• **"Raag Tarangini" **is a musical treatise written by** Lochan Kavi in the 15th century**.
 
• It is considered as one of the earliest and most comprehensive works on Indian classical music.
 
• The text is divided into two parts, with the first part focusing on the theoretical aspects of music and the second part discussing the practical aspects of singing and playing instruments.
 
 
 
• **"Hridayprakash" is a text on Ayurvedic medicine**, written by Madhava Upadhyaya. It is not related to music.
 
• ** "Sangeet Darpan" is a text on Indian classical music**, written by Damodar Gupt. It is not ascribed to Lochan Kavi.
 
• ** "Anup Vilas" is a text on Indian classical dance**, written by Raghunatha Shiromani. It is not related to music.
 
• Hence, the statement "In the 15th century, a text called Raag Tarangini is ascribed popularly to Lochan Kavi" is correct.
